tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Existence of minimizer, obstacle problem] ↗ def:admissible-class-obstacle-problem 1. ch8:8.4-thm-3\group Variational Inequalities

Assume the admissible set $\mathcal{A}$ is nonempty. Then there exists a unique function $u \in \mathcal{A}$ satisfying \[ I[u] = \min _{w \in \mathcal{A}} I[w]. \]

Proof

\sketch The obstacle class is convex and weakly closed. Coercivity, weak compactness, and lower semicontinuity give a minimizer; strict convexity of the Dirichlet energy on $H_0^1(U)$ gives uniqueness.

□
